source.author: verg
source.text: Iuvenes, quae causa subegit ignotas temptare vias, quo tenditis? inquit.
source.text_original: 'Iuvenes, quae causa subegit / ignotas temptare vias, quo tenditis?' inquit.
source.text_english: Young men, what reason has driven you to try unknown roads? Where are you heading? he said.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Et notanda brevitas, quam admirari in Virgilio solebamus: Juvenes, quae causa subegit Ignotas tentare vias, quo tenditis, inquit: Qui genus: unde domo, pacemne huc fertis, an arma?
reuse.text_original: Et notanda brevitas, quam admirari in Virgilio solebamus: Juvenes, quae causa subegit Ignotas tentare vias, quo tenditis, inquit: Qui genus: unde domo, pacemne huc fertis, an arma?
reuse.text_english: And the brevity is to be noted, the kind we used to admire in Vergil: Young men, what cause has driven you to try unknown roads, where are you heading, he says; what race? from what home? are you bringing peace here, or arms?
